entries.zh: 卸桅；拆卸船具（拆下船桅，解除船只装备）
entries.en: to dismantle the ship; to unstep the mast, strip a vessel of its rigging
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（住/拄），据官话栏 sie my 推读为「卸桅」，西语词头 desmantelar la nave 指拆解船只桅樯装备。

entries.en: to faint, to swoon; to lose consciousness
to faint from a wound; wound, injury
to crumble; to break or crush into small pieces
to break stone into pieces

entries.zh: 吐舌（伸舌以示否认、嘲弄）
entries.en: to thrust out the tongue (as denial or mockery); to deny with the tongue out
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 词头已划删，汉字与闽南语栏残缺、官话栏空白，无法立义（词形或为 deshonrar 之误写，仅备考）。

entries.zh: 水浸冲塌（城墙、土岸为水所蚀而崩落）
entries.en: to crumble away by water (earthen wall or bank undermined and collapsing)
entries.notes: 汉字疑为「戌/城」，依音写 chiāng/châⁿ 定为「城」，指水土冲蚀致墙体崩坍。

entries.en: to collapse, to crumble down (of high structures)
to undress, to take off; to untie
to bare the arm; to strip the arm bare
to strip by force; to flay, to peel off
naked; bare, exposed
naked; bare
entries.notes: 闽南语栏第二音节声调号为 T99 污损难辨，按封存件规程降为低置信；字义四栏互证（赤＝赤裸）。

entries.en: naked (with the body exposed)

entries.zh: 全身剥光（剥身斥斥：赤条条、一丝不挂）
entries.en: stark naked; stripped bare from head to foot
entries.notes: 「斥斥」二字存疑（或作「庀庀」），从西语 desnudo de todo punto 定为全身剥光。

entries.en: naked with the body exposed; stark naked
wholly naked
entries.notes: 末字存疑（斥/体），闽南语栏 tè 与官话栏 thŷ 略有出入，从西语 desnudo todo 定为全身赤裸。

entries.en: stark naked; bare

entries.zh: 身体裸露（身放现：袒露其身）
entries.en: with the body exposed or bared
